title: Chapter 55: Thought Stamp
content:
Chapter 55: Thought Stamp

"Now is the time for you to fulfill your promise!" Wang Shuo looked at Gu Liji and said in a deep voice.

"Lord, why can't I understand what you are saying?"

"Why do you have to pretend to be confused? Didn't we have a bet before?" Wang Shuo said with interest.

Only then did Gu Liji realize that she had a fight with Wang Shuo because of this. Then her face changed and she showed the look of a little daughter. She smiled sweetly and said, "Lord, isn't this slave already yours?"

Wang Shuo couldn't help but sigh when he saw the appearance of this changeable woman. She was indeed an assassin. This disguise really revealed her true feelings.

"There's no need to use a honey trap on me. I'm interested in your ability, not your beauty!"

As he said that, he took out the "Thought Steel Seal Scroll". This scroll is different from the "Contract Scroll" in that it is one-time use. After use, it is gone.

"By signing this contract, the agreement between you and me will be considered completed."

Wang Shuo didn't dare to look at Gu Liji.

He couldn't help but sigh in his heart, this woman was quite attractive.

Due to long-term martial arts practice, Gu Liji has a well-proportioned and graceful figure. Coupled with her charming expression at this moment, I really feel pity for her!

Guliji was in a fierce struggle inside.

After a while, a look of despair appeared on his face, and he muttered: "Lord, are you really not going to let the little girl go?"

"Don't worry, this is just for you to join my battle order and perform some tasks. After all, you have a fighting profession. Staying in the village and being an ordinary citizen is really a bit unfair!"

Seeing that Wang Shuo was indifferent, Gu Liji had no choice but to abide by the agreement.

The method of using the Thought Seal Scroll is similar to that of the Contract Scroll.

"ID: SAC56781102 Gu Liji, volunteers to become a subordinate of Lord ID: SAC5678 Wang Shuo, obey his orders, protect his safety, and never betray."

After reciting the oath, Gu Liji knew that this was a contract of betrayal. From now on, she would never be free again!

After hesitating for a long time, under Wang Shuo's gaze, she pressed her fingerprints.

The thought steel seal scroll took effect and then turned into ashes.

And Gu Liji's loyalty has directly become 100/100.

Wang Shuo checked her attributes.

[ID:56781102 Gu Liji]

[Level: Level 7]

[Belongs to: Wana Village (Wang Shuo)]

[Loyalty: 100/100]

【Strength: 21】

[Physique: 14]

[Agility: 19]

[Energy: 13]

(Qualification: E level, each level provides 1 free attribute point.)

[Combat attribute panel]

[Attack power: 21]

[Defense: 10]

[Health value: 840]

[Skill: Backstab]

Wang Shuo felt relieved and returned his weapons, two-hand blades and protective gear to her.

At this moment, Gu Liji felt as if a belief had been forcibly implanted in her mind.

The meaning of her life is to obey Wang Shuo's orders.

For this, even if it means paying the price of life, he will not hesitate.

Apart from this change of obeying Wang Shuoyan, she was no different from other refugees.

They still have their own independent thinking and judgment, which is essentially different from tool people.

Wang Shuo was very satisfied when he saw the respectful Gu Liji in front of him.

Now that time is running out, the most important thing is to go out quickly and gather more refugees.

With Gu Liji who was completely loyal to him guarding the territory, Wang Shuo finally felt relieved.

After giving her some authority over the Arrow Tower and other territories, Wang Shuo took Gong Zheng and others and began the sweep work again.

The open area at the foot of Wadang Mountain is not very large, and it has now been completely included in the sphere of influence of Wana Village.

Wang Shuo can now use the mini map to find out whether there are other refugees in this area.

This brought great convenience to Wang Shuo. Soon, he discovered some hidden refugees, and then captured them all, and got more than 20 people.

However, this area is really small, only 2 kilometers in radius.

There is a total area of 5 kilometers around Wana Village, which is a flat open land. To the north is Wadang Mountain. The mountain is not very high, and you can occasionally hear the sounds of wild animals.

To the east is the wide Xiangshui River, with many rapids and dangerous shoals, and the sound of the water hitting it makes a clanging sound!

The west is an endless stretch of hills, with low hills rising one after another.

To the south is the vast prairie, endless as far as the eye can see, with no end in sight.

Wang Shuo planned to explore this side of Wadang Mountain first and discover potential dangers.

In the evening, Wang Shuo captured eight more refugees. There were no more refugees in the area from Wadang Mountain to Wana Village.

At the same time, Wang Shuo also discovered a suspected copy within this range, but he did not explore it in depth.

In the evening, Wang Shuo once again allowed the arrested refugees to join the village, bringing the total number to 43.

At the same time, many resources were obtained again.

[Wood +22821, Stone +21390, Iron Ore +14320, Soul Crystal +13, Energy Crystal +5730, Gold Coin +22100]

There were several other items, which surprised Wang Shuo, and he also got a treasure map fragment (1/3).

The armor and weapons were returned to them, after all, they still needed some combat power.

After having dinner with everyone again, Wang Shuo found that the speed of building residential houses was quite slow.

Compared with the speed of system construction, it was dozens of times slower, but fortunately, the refugees all had skills. Although there were some restrictions, they were still useful, and with the blessing of attributes, the efficiency was still many times faster than that of ordinary people.

In one afternoon, only two residential houses were built, with a total of 6 houses. Originally, each house was for 2 people to live in, but now it seems that they must squeeze in tonight.

Fortunately, the system is not making trouble now. If there is another acid rain or extremely cold weather, I believe that many players hiding in the wild will probably be in trouble!

Wang Shuo arranged the people who could not fit into the residential houses in the spare rooms in the courtyard, and then returned to his bedroom.

At this time, he had time to digest what he did today and whether there were any omissions.

Every step now will have a significant impact on the future, so we must be careful and maximize efficiency.

First, he took out his "Survivor's Handbook" and flipped through it from beginning to end.

The [Attribute Panel] has changed a lot, and it is directly divided into 3 pages.

Including territory attributes, personal basic attributes and combat attributes.

In the combat attribute panel, experience value attributes also appear.

The [Task] column in the [Task Panel] has also changed a lot.

(Day 21, 8:31 pm)

The time is still in the upper right corner, but the number of survivors in the current area has disappeared.

[Main Quest]: Survive.

[Side Quest]

1. Find the nearest town.

2. Upgrade and switch to a combat profession. (Completed)

3. Guard the territory.

Task 1 and Task 3 seem to conflict!

But Wang Shuo thought about it and realized that if his territory was strong enough, there would be no conflict.

It seems that he has to take time to go to Nanshan while defending his territory.
